title: Keep Your Tires Ready for Saskatoon's Fall Roads
caption: With cooler temps approaching, check your tire pressure monthly. Under‑inflated tires can reduce fuel economy and handling. Also, inspect tread depth—Saskatoon’s mix of rain and occasional early snow makes good traction essential. A quick pressure check takes 5 minutes and can save you a surprise on the road.
image_prompt: A mechanic checking tire pressure on a vehicle with the Saskatoon skyline visible in the background, autumn leaves on the ground.

title: When Your Car Acts Like It Needs a Coffee
caption: We’ve all been there: the engine’s sluggish, the dash lights are blinking, and you swear the car is begging for caffeine. Share this with a friend who’s ever been stuck waiting for a tow. 🚗☕ #SaskatoonLife #CarProblems

title: A Quick Pit Stop at the Riverfront
caption: Yesterday we rolled up to the South Saskatchewan Riverfront to fix a flat for a local cyclist turned driver. It was a sunny afternoon, and the owner treated us to a coffee from the nearby kiosk. Nothing beats a little community vibe while your car gets the care it needs.
image_prompt: A Fixaur Mobile Mechanic van parked near the river in Saskatoon, a barista handing a coffee through the window, and a cyclist smiling in the background.

title: Brake Safety: Don't Wait Until It's Too Late
caption: If you hear squealing, feel a pulsation, or notice your stopping distance increasing, have your brakes inspected right away. In Saskatoon’s stop‑and‑go traffic and icy winters, reliable brakes are a must. Ignoring warning signs can turn a simple pad replacement into a costly repair. Book a mobile inspection today—your safety matters.
image_prompt: A close‑up of brake pads and rotors with a safety alert icon, set against a snowy Saskatoon street scene.
